summary: Tested app-wide localization (EN/ES/FR) via Expo web preview on mobile viewport (390x844). Language picker appears on fresh sessions with three options and Continue button (all working). Picking French → Age Gate, Auth, Home, Library, Profile all render in French. Tab labels translate correctly (Accueil / Danses / Mes danses / Instructeur / Profil). Placeholder interpolation for names is stable across screens ('Salut, Erin !', 'Suggérer une danse à Jamin' — no literal {name} anywhere). Spanish and English screens also render correctly. NO red RN screen or JS crash. HOWEVER: a CRITICAL i18n bug affects the LEGAL FOOTER on the Auth screen (sign-in and sign-up) and on the Age Gate modal in ALL THREE LANGUAGES — the footer renders as, e.g., 'En continuant vous acceptez nos [missing "%Conditions" value] et notre [missing "%Politique de confidentialité" value].' Root cause is a conflict between the new `toRuntimeString` rewriter and the existing string-split rendering in auth.tsx / AgeGateModal.tsx (see rca_of_issue).

ui_bugs.issue: Legal footer under sign-in and sign-up shows literal '[missing "%Conditions" value] ... [missing "%Politique de confidentialité" value]' (analogous in ES: '[missing "%Términos" value]' / EN: '[missing "%Terms" value]'). Cause: the runtime pre-processor `toRuntimeString` in /app/frontend/src/i18n/index.ts:67 rewrites `{terms}` → `%{terms}` at nest time, but /app/frontend/app/auth.tsx lines 455–491 still call `t('auth.legal_signin').split('{terms}')` etc. Since `{terms}`/`{privacy}` no longer exist in the returned string, the split fails; and because `t()` interpolates immediately with no params, i18n-js emits `[missing "%{terms}" value]`, which then splits at the literal `{terms}` INSIDE that missing-value template, producing the mangled output shown.

Same root cause as auth footer. `/app/frontend/src/components/AgeGateModal.tsx:142-147` splits on `{emph}`, `{terms}`, `{privacy}` but toRuntimeString has replaced those with `%{...}`. Rendered output (FR): 'En appuyant sur [missing "%J'ai 13 ans ou plus" value] vous acceptez nos [missing "%Conditions" value] et notre [missing "%Politique de confidentialité" value].' Affects EN/ES/FR.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking: several 'shadow*'/'textShadow*'/'pointerEvents' deprecation warnings on web. Not caused by this feature — pre-existing.

action_items: Fix the legal-footer rendering conflict. Recommended fix in /app/frontend/app/auth.tsx and /app/frontend/src/components/AgeGateModal.tsx: change `.split('{terms}')`, `.split('{privacy}')`, `.split('{emph}')` to `.split('%{terms}')`, `.split('%{privacy}')`, `.split('%{emph}')` (since toRuntimeString has already converted them). Alternatively — cleaner — expose a raw-catalog getter in /app/frontend/src/i18n/index.ts that returns the pre-`toRuntimeString` source string (e.g. `tRaw(key)` reading from `translations[locale][key]` directly) and use `tRaw` in the three legal-footer render blocks that need to split-and-render clickable substrings. Or simplest: keep authoring braces as `{terms}` but ALSO leave literal `{terms}` markers in place by having toRuntimeString skip if the caller opts-out (e.g. keys ending in `_split`). Either way, patch and retest FR/ES/EN Auth + Age Gate legal lines.

After fix, re-verify: FR auth footer reads 'En continuant vous acceptez nos Conditions et notre Politique de confidentialité.' with Terms and Privacy words as tappable links; identical checks for ES and EN.
critical_code_review_comments: toRuntimeString is a global rewrite applied to every value in the catalog, but three specific call-sites still consume the raw `{ident}` tokens by string-splitting. Any future translation using single-brace placeholders + split-based rendering will silently break the same way — consider documenting this contract or adding a lint/unit test that fails when a translation containing `{ident}` is consumed by a caller not passing that param.

rca_of_issue: Reproduction: (1) Open app in fresh browser → picker appears. (2) Pick any language (FR/ES/EN) → Continue. (3) Age Gate appears — its legal footer already shows '[missing "%..." value]' markers. (4) Confirm 13+; Auth screen appears — its legal footer at bottom (both signin and signup tabs) also shows the same '[missing "%..." value]' markers. Root cause: /app/frontend/src/i18n/index.ts introduces a `toRuntimeString(v)` pre-processor (lines 67-77) that rewrites authoring-style `{ident}` to i18n-js's `%{ident}` at catalog-nest time. This works for call-sites that pass params to `t(key, {ident: value})`. But three call-sites — /app/frontend/app/auth.tsx lines 455-491 and /app/frontend/src/components/AgeGateModal.tsx lines 142-147 — deliberately DON'T pass params; instead they call `t(key)` and `.split('{ident}')` on the result to inject React elements (clickable Terms and Privacy links, and bold `<Text>` for the emph). Because `{terms}` etc. no longer exist in the returned string (they were rewritten to `%{terms}`, which then i18n-js interpolates to the string `[missing "%{terms}" value]` since no param was passed), the `.split('{terms}')` splits AT the literal `{terms}` substring that survives inside `[missing "%{terms}" value]`, producing the observed mangled output. Mitigation: See action_items — either switch the three call-sites to `.split('%{terms}')`, or add a `tRaw()` helper that returns the un-rewritten catalog string for split-and-render use cases. Neither change touches translations.ts.
